name: figma-proxy-mcp
title: Figma Proxy MCP — Figma to code with visual diff
description: Hosted read-only Figma MCP server for AI coding agents: compact design IR, CSS variables, Tailwind theme, PNG/SVG export and visual diff (SSIM) of your HTML against the Figma frame. Bring your own Figma token.

inputSchema.title: Figma Proxy MCP
inputSchema.description: No input needed. This Actor runs in Standby mode as an MCP server: connect your MCP client to the Standby URL with your Apify token (Authorization header) and your Figma token (x-figma-token header).
